source: FOX Sports outright title odds board
note: Champion-futures odds for the 8 live quarter-finalists, snapshotted before the quarter-finals. De-vigged with the power method (same as the sharp-market baseline). The site headline champion probability is a linear pool (1-w)*model + w*market with w=0.5 for the knockout stage; the model-only and market-only numbers are kept alongside. Weight rationale: our own model gives ~51-54% on the decisive top-team matchups (near coin-flip), so once the field narrows to bunched elites we weight the sharp market equally rather than lean on Elo's thin edge.
